credibility.summary: Management tends to over-promise on overall revenue growth targets and adhesive segment margins, frequently missing full-year and subsidiary margin expectations.

narrative_vs_numbers: Promised 20% full-year FY26 growth in Nov 2025, but actual Mar 2026 annual revenue grew only 12.64%.
Guided 15-16% stable adhesive margins, but actual UK margins fell to 7.33% and 4.9%, and India adhesive margins fell to 12.2%.
Promised 16-18% plumbing EBITDA margin in Aug 2026, which was delivered with an actual reported margin of 18.9%.
